title: U.S. Voter FAQs: 2024 and 2026
description: This database puts every 2024 voter FAQ question next to its 2026 version.

pairs.title: Voter FAQ questions, 2024 vs 2026
pairs.description_html:
Each row puts a 2024 voter FAQ question next to its 2026 version. The result column says what changed. New and removed questions only have one year filled in. Most Vote411 rows compare whole sections of a page instead of single questions.

How to use it

  • Click a value in the result box below to see just that kind of change.
  • To see one state, choose state in the - column - menu, type its full name in the box next to it (like Oregon), and click Apply filters.
  • To search for a word, choose a column like question_2026, change = to contains, type the word, and click Apply filters.
  • Click a number in the Link column to read both years' full answers.
